Option A: Developing and developed regions share similarly in wealth through trade.
Option B: The core will always dominate the periphery.
Option C: Growth and prosperity of the core exists at the expense of the periphery.
Option D: Regions with initial advantage keep and expand it as they attract labor, capital, and trade.
